decisiveReasons: N08 and N09 are the remaining two nodes in the same OOD track and share the existing source schema, validator/scorer, version/QSet, artifact, consumer and admission path; one integration cycle is coherent while 18 unit reviews stay bounded.

The approach treats exact source observations as preflight evidence, not semantic acceptance; it preserves named control facets, distinguishes contract gaps from false keys, and requires item-level decision and identity review against accepted N01-N07.

It preserves the accepted 1089-question cohort, existing ordinary N01 pool, artifacts, source guards and predecessor chain, and leaves the unknown closed-proof shape for a separate independent review after the identity map is accepted.

The independently recorded PO decision defers the other eight banks' further content review/repairs to maintenance while OOD and shared BIZQ-01 continue; this batch neither accepts those banks nor adds a release gate.

The proposal keeps the existing pipeline and authority boundaries and introduces no replacement quota, option/prose quota, selector widening, alternate pipeline, new authority, product rule, or publication permission.
